<observations>
Date: Mar 2, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User is building Ledgerly, a TypeScript invoicing SaaS targeting freelancers in Canada.
* 🔴 (09:05) User prefers using VSCode extensions for linting.
* 🔴 (09:14) User's teammate Priyanka Vashisht reviews all database migrations.
* 🟡 (11:45) Agent successfully set up the project, installed dependencies, and compiled the TypeScript codebase without errors.
* 🟡 (14:00) Agent added a placeholder `generateInvoicePdf` function in `src/invoice/render.ts` using PDFKit (already a dependency).
* ✅ (16:40) Agent created unit tests for the PDF generation function using Jest, and all passed.
* 🔴 (21:30) User decided to name the primary database schema `ledgerly_core`.

Date: Mar 5, 2026
* 🔴 (07:45) User decided to protect the API with JWT authentication.
* ✅ (10:00) Agent implemented JWT token generation with a stub in `src/auth/jwt.ts` and created passing Jest unit tests.
* 🟡 (11:30) Agent configured continuous integration with GitHub Actions, including node 18, npm install, build, and test steps, and verified it locally.
* 🔴 (13:00) User wants automatic version bumping using `standard-version`.
* ✅ (14:30) Agent added an npm script "release" for `standard-version` and generated a changelog entry.
* 🟡 (15:15) User asked about using Stripe for payment processing; `stripe-node` v4.5.0 is already a dependency.
* 🟡 (17:30) Agent created a placeholder `chargeCustomer` function in `src/payments/stripe.ts`.

Date: Mar 8, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User decided to implement audit logging for all invoice modifications.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent created `src/audit/logger.ts` with a basic `logInfo` function, noting `winston` v3.8.2 is a dependency.
* ✅ (09:35) Agent integrated the logger into `src/invoice/render.ts` to call `logger.logInfo` after PDF generation.
* 🟡 (11:45) Agent configured Jest to collect coverage, achieving 87% coverage, meeting the user's aim for at least 85%.
* ✅ (12:30) Agent committed the audit logger and coverage improvements.
* 🔴 (13:45) User decided to send logs to Loggly via HTTP endpoint.
* ✅ (15:00) Agent added Loggly transport configuration and wrote a passing Jest test mocking the Loggly endpoint.

Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🟡 (08:30) Agent merged the `feature/pdf-generation` branch into `main` and opened a pull request.
* 🔴 (09:45) User asked whether the generated PDF should include QR codes for payment links.
* ✅ (10:55) Agent added QR code generation to `src/invoice/render.ts` and updated tests to verify its presence.
* 🔴 (12:45) User decided to expose a new endpoint `GET /invoices/:id/pdf` for downloading invoices.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent created `src/routes/invoicePdf.ts` with an Express handler and a passing integration test.
* 🔴 (14:20) User stated the production Postgres instance runs in the Frankfurt region.
* 🟡 (14:40) User wants to monitor endpoint latency with Prometheus.
* ✅ (16:00) Agent added Prometheus middleware and instrumented the PDF endpoint, then updated the README with usage examples.

Date: Mar 15, 2026
* 🔴 (07:20) User decided to add email notifications for invoice delivery confirmations.
* 🟡 (07:55) Agent scaffolded `sendInvoiceEmail` in `src/notifications/email.ts` and installed `nodemailer@6.9.3`.
* ✅ (09:45) Agent implemented an HTML email template using Handlebars and created passing Jest tests mocking SMTP.
* 🟡 (11:50) Agent added a custom Prometheus histogram metric for PDF generation duration after a reported latency spike.
* ✅ (12:35) Agent updated the CI workflow to lint Handlebars templates, which passed.
* 🔴 (14:00) User requested to containerize the application with Docker for easier staging deployments.
* ✅ (16:40) Agent wrote a Dockerfile, built the image locally, and pushed it to GitHub Container Registry as `v1.3.0-staging`.

Date: Mar 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User will begin end-to-end testing of the invoice flow tomorrow.
* ✅ (09:30) Agent installed `Cypress@13.2.0`, scaffolded `cypress/integration/invoice_spec.ts`, and ran an initial smoke test successfully.
* 🟡 (10:15) User asked about using Sentry for error tracking in production.
* ✅ (11:45) Agent added `@sentry/node@7.14.0` and created a unit test for Sentry initialization.
* 🟡 (12:30) User requested a health-check endpoint returning JSON status.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent created `src/routes/health.ts` exposing `GET /health` with uptime and version fields, and added a passing integration test.
* 🟡 (14:45) User mentioned needing rate limiting on the PDF download endpoint.
* 🟡 (15:30) Agent installed `express-rate-limit@6.7.0` and applied middleware to `src/routes/invoicePdf.ts`.
* 🔴 (16:05) User prefers `pnpm` over `npm` for all install commands.
* ✅ (16:15) Agent updated README with instructions for configuring `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS` and `MAX_REQUESTS`.
</observations>
<current-task>
Primary: Prepare for user's end-to-end testing of the invoice flow.
Secondary: Address user's preference for Sentry error tracking.
</current-task>
<suggested-response>
The assistant should acknowledge the user's preference for `pnpm` and confirm readiness for the end-to-end testing.
</suggested-response>
